subject: Request: Scoped SSO handoff + SCIM export for SIG portal review
messages:
From: Anjali Rao <anjali@sig-reviewers.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: SigOps Team <sigops@brightline.health>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG intake — scoped SCIM export + SSO samples

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG intake for Brightline Health we need a scoped SCIM export and a few SSO (SAML) assertion samples for a handful of user types. To keep the review tight, can you provide: 1) a SCIM CSV limited to the Brightline tenant (include user_id, email, role, department, last_active_at) with a 90-day window; 2) three SAML assertion samples (service account, admin, clinician) with timestamps redacted except for the format; and 3) a short README explaining how records were filtered/redacted.

Timeline: SIG reviewers need these artifacts by EOD Monday (2026-11-16) so we can finish our mapping. If you prefer, a staged handoff (export first, assertions later) is fine — just call out what is coming when.

Let me know if you need additional access or a Drive folder to drop files.

Thanks — Anjali
Security Analyst, SIG Reviewers
Anjali Rao | anjali@sig-reviewers.com

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Anjali Rao <anjali@sig-reviewers.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — scoped SCIM export + SSO samples

Hi Anjali —

Acknowledged. Routing to IAM artifacts lane. Laura, Karthik — can you take point on producing the scoped SCIM CSV and the SAML samples? Key asks from Anjali: 90-day SCIM export scoped to Brightline tenant (fields: user_id, email, role, department, last_active_at), three SAML assertion examples with format-only timestamps, and a README describing filtering/redaction.

I can provide a Drive folder for drop and coordinate the transfer (we’ll avoid sending full assertions to external email). If there's any blocked data (PII) we'll redact per the playbook.

Target: initial SCIM CSV by Monday 11/16 10:00 PT, SAML samples by Monday 16:00 PT. If that’s tight, tell me what you need and I’ll escalate capacity.

— Mateo
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, Anjali Rao <anjali@sig-reviewers.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: SIG intake — scoped SCIM export + SSO samples

Hi all —

Attached are the artifacts: scim_scoped_export_20261115.csv, saml_assertion_samples.xml, and a short scim-export-readme.md. Notes:

- SCIM export approach: we ran a tenant-scoped delta for Brightline (tenant_id=brigh-1002) covering 2026-08-15 to 2026-11-15. Output columns included user_id (internal GUID), work_email (redacted for personal domains), role (mapped to RBAC buckets: clinician, admin, svc_account), department, and last_active_at (ISO8601). We redacted personal email local parts, keeping domain to allow mapping, per the redaction policy.

- SAML samples: three assertions provided. All time elements are replaced with placeholders like <TIMESTAMP_FORMAT:2026-11-15T15:04:00Z>. We preserved NameID formats and attribute statements for role and department. No raw tokens/cookies included.

- Validation: we ran a quick profile check against the SIG sample schema and included a report line in README indicating 0 schema errors.

Attachments (zipped in Drive): scim_scoped_export_20261115.csv (5.2 KB), saml_assertion_samples.xml (12 KB), scim-export-readme.md (1.1 KB).

If you need additional fields (manager, employee_type) or unredacted emails under an NDA, let us know and we can arrange a narrower secure transfer.

Thanks — Laura
Senior Technical Program Manager, Security Compliance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: scim_scoped_export_20261115.csv (CSV, 5.2 KB)
Attachment: saml_assertion_samples.xml (XML, 12 KB)
Attachment: scim-export-readme.md (text, 1.1 KB)

From: Anjali Rao <anjali@sig-reviewers.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: SigOps Team <sigops@brightline.health>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — scoped SCIM export + SSO samples

Laura / Mateo —

Received, thank you. ScIM CSV looks consistent with what we requested and the README is helpful. A couple of quick follow-ups: 1) can you confirm the mapping rule used to translate internal role strings to "clinician" vs "admin"? (one-line is fine); 2) for the service-account assertion, can you indicate whether the assertion was generated by a CI service or a long-lived service key? We don't need raw keys, just an origin note.

If you can drop those clarifications in the Drive README or paste here we can close the SIG ticket. Otherwise this looks good and we'll proceed with mapping.

Best — Anjali
Security Analyst, SIG Reviewers
